international.title: Religious messages agriculture secretary emailed to staff deemed unconstitutional
international.summary: A federal judge ruled that messages sent by Brooke Rollins to USDA workers suggest Christianity is a shared faith and violate the first amendment Religious messages that US agriculture secretary Brooke Rollins emailed to the agency’s 100,000 employees were unconstitutional, and she must be careful to avoid proselytizing when communicating with workers, a federal judge ruled Thursday. Rollins sent the messages, which included Christian messages and images, from her official email account on holidays such as Independence Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter. She did not send messages commemorating holidays from other religions. Continue reading...
